readme_excerpt: Apache Flink Apache Flink is an open source stream processing framework with powerful stream- and batch-processing capabilities. Learn more about Flink at https://flink.apache.org/ Features A streaming-first runtime that supports both batch processing and data streaming programs Elegant and fluent APIs in Java A runtime that supports very high throughput and low event latency at the same time Support for event time and out-of-order processing in the DataStream API, based on the Dataflow Model F…
